decisions.reason: The request for an updated package after testing and error fixing changes the package deliverable, but does not change the required style-set coverage or additions.
The source requests a post-testing package and does not modify the required manual line-break behavior.
The package-delivery request does not change the required editable-field mechanism, intended use, or legacy-field handling.
The source does not resolve or modify the table-layout requirement or its existing technical ambiguity; it only requests an updated package after testing and fixes.
The package request does not alter any bullet appearance, scaling, alignment, color, or level requirements.
Although testing and error fixing may involve copy-paste behavior, the source does not change its expected behavior, test sources, target version, or unresolved workflow.
The source does not modify or resolve the required Tab-controlled hierarchy behavior; it only establishes when an updated package should be sent.
The updated-package request is a later delivery obligation and does not change the initial due-diligence assessment method, budget, coverage, or outputs.
The source does not change the required field-label language, text, coverage, or matching rule.
The request for a package after error fixes does not independently modify the required placeholder-clearing behavior.
The source does not change any typography, emphasis, font-size, or caption-text requirement.
The updated-package request does not change the required theme-color palette or its inclusion in the style system.
